files.README.md:
# Task Board

Create tasks and move them between To do, In progress and Done. Each status change appends a revision with a stable task ID. The board displays the latest revision for each task, including older records without task IDs. Up to 1,000 creation/status events are stored. An uncertain save has an explicit retry using the same request ID.
